title: Vikram and Betal: The Lost Ring

scenes.summary: Betal tells a story about a lost ring.
scenes.text: Betal told Vikram about a man who lost his ring.
scenes.image_prompt: vikram carrying betal in forest cartoon style

scenes.text: The man could not find his ring and asked the king for help.
scenes.image_prompt: man worried about missing ring cartoon

scenes.text: The minister gave flowers to all servants to find the thief.
scenes.image_prompt: minister giving flowers to servants cartoon

scenes.text: The thief became nervous and behaved differently.
The minister identified the thief by his behavior. Vikram answered wisely, and Betal flew away.
scenes.image_prompt: minister pointing at guilty servant cartoon

story: A man lost his ring. A minister used a clever trick to observe behavior and find the thief. Vikram said fear reveals the truth.
